review.images: The lead render is the named hero on Aldar’s Canopies corporate page. Eight other scenes come from the Canopies launch gallery and project sections. Checked both portrait render composition and wider views of the club, interior and outdoor areas. Excluded duplicate crops, background textures and the Yas Point title image. Corporate page: https://www.aldar.com/properties/en/uae/yas-island/the-canopies-at-yas-point
review.location: Visually reviewed Aldar’s brochure page 6, including the project marker and the five published times used here. Regional locations and planned attractions remain qualified. Excluded the general Dubai estimate because the endpoint is unspecified. Project-name directions are used because an exact entrance pin was unavailable.
review.floorPlans: Reelly-hosted 16-page original matched the previously cached bytes. Verified all ten residential drawing spreads, physical pages 7–16, including the side-by-side plans. Physical pages 1–6 are building floor plates and remain in the PDF. No exact sizes are printed beside the types.

unavailable: Signed drawing-specific areas and entrance coordinates.
